intent: Recover, consolidate, and operationalise the Drug Resilience Atlas across Notion, GitHub, Supabase, and atlas web surfaces.
hard_truth: The prior thread stalled because it repeatedly asked for confirmation and claimed MCP power without executing. This job converts that stalled work into concrete repository-backed execution instructions.

core_model.premise: Substances can temporarily fill or simulate missing regulatory states in dopamine, serotonin, GABA, endorphin, stress, sensory, or executive-function systems, but rebound/crash risk differs by neurotype and lived context.

execution_tasks.name: Search all available stores
actions: Search GitHub org TML-4PM for all DRA terms across repos and issues.
Search atlas-aus-pulse repo for drug/neuro/resilience terms.
Search drug-resilience-atlas repo if present.
Search Supabase public schema for tables/columns/content matching DRA terms.
Search Notion for page/database names and properties matching DRA terms.
Search local Mac/Google Drive only through authorised MCP endpoint or Mac worker, never by assuming direct chat access.

execution_tasks.name: Build canonical data model
actions: Create Supabase tables for substances, populations, neurochemical pathways, impact observations, source evidence, hypotheses, theory tests, and ledger entries.
Use archive-only update pattern; no destructive deletes.
Include RLS policies and indexes for queryability.

execution_tasks.name: Seed V1 substance matrix
actions: Seed Cannabis, MDMA, Methamphetamine, Cocaine, Opiates, Alcohol, Nicotine.
Seed ADHD, Autism, Dyslexia, Indigenous populations, Elderly, Neurotypical baseline.
Create at least one impact observation per substance x population lens from V1B/initial PDFs where evidence exists; mark uncertain entries PARTIAL rather than invented.

execution_tasks.name: Populate Notion DRA Master Index
actions: Find DRA - Master Index database.
Populate existing blank substance pages with canonical profile, neurodiversity impact table, harm-reduction notes, and evidence links.
Create missing pages if absent.
Write backlink to GitHub receipt and Supabase row ids.

execution_tasks.name: Wire atlas web surface
actions: Add searchable DRA content layer to atlas-aus-pulse or separate DRA route.
Expose filters by substance, neurotype, neurochemical pathway, evidence status, and hypothesis status.
Include disclaimer: research and harm-reduction information, not medical advice.

execution_tasks.name: Create research expansion loop
actions: Add hypothesis table for testing theories as research expands.
Add source ingestion queue for papers, chat notes, Notion pages, PDFs, web links, and practitioner observations.
Add review states: NEW, TRIAGED, EVIDENCE_BOUND, NEEDS_REVIEW, PUBLISHED, RETIRED.
Add contradiction handling: conflicting claims preserved with separate evidence, not overwritten.

execution_tasks.name: Proof and receipts
actions: Write machine receipt JSON and human receipt MD.
Classify current state honestly as PARTIAL until Notion/Supabase/web writes are executed and proven.
After execution, update status to REAL only with evidence URLs, commit SHAs, table row counts, and smoke-test output.

completion_gates: Smoke test proves queryable substance x population matrix
